title: Termy
description: A native, GPU-rendered terminal workspace for AI-agent workflows: sessions grouped by project, tabs and splits, and a 100% local token monitor for Claude Code, Codex and Gemini CLI. Zero telemetry — not a single networking crate in the dependency tree.
approach: Written in Rust on top of wgpu, so it renders through Metal on macOS, DirectX 12 on Windows and Vulkan on Linux. Terminal emulation comes from alacritty_terminal with one instance per session, the PTY from portable-pty, text from glyphon and the settings panel from egui. Config lives in a TOML file that hot-reloads, and saving from the panel keeps your comments and formatting.
